state:
Goal `core-router-and-4-more`, stage 2 (feature proofs). `Core\Router::match` and `Core\Router::methodsFor` have every feature proof on disk: about, three examples each, an attack each, a bench each with a recorded figure, and a Rust `covers:` test each in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/router.rs`'s test module. `Core\Router` has its class card and is off `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`. The `match` and `methodsFor` cards are rewritten plainly.

`bun nv proofs --owed --group 'Core\Router'` names four members still owing examples, hostile, perf and tests: `url`, `urlAbsolute`, `urlSigned` and `signedRoute`. The installed handoff listed only `signedRoute` of these. All five `Core\Router\Match` members owe examples, help, hostile, perf and tests. `Core\Script`, `Core\Script\ExitReport` and `Core\Secret` are not started.

next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/router.rs` and the `Core/Router` trees under `docs/examples/`, `tests/hostile/` and `benches/members/`.

items.text: **`Core\Router::url`** — owes examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). A program with `#[Route]`s and no request can call it, so no `.nvsr` is needed; its card at `URL_DOC` wants a plain rewrite. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/router.rs:222`

**`Core\Router::urlAbsolute`** — same owed list. It needs a configured `[[app]] origin`, so check how an existing conformance case sets one before writing the examples. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/router.rs:231`

**`Core\Router::urlSigned` and `::signedRoute`** — same owed list, one feature each. `signedRoute` reads the request the door matched, so its examples, attack and bench need a `.nvsr` request file beside each; `docs/examples/core/Response/stream/` shows that shape. The Rust tests `url_signed_verifies_through_signed_route_after_the_mount_prefix_changes` and `signed_route_verifies_against_the_match_the_server_already_made_and_reparses_nothing` need only `// covers:` lines. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/router.rs:273`

backlog: `Core\Router\Match::name`, `::params`, `::param`, `::method`, `::access` — examples, help, hostile, perf, tests; `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/router.rs:608`. `Core\Router::match` gives a match with no request.
